kind: two invented languages of about 22,000 words each, taught one after the other into one learner, every training window presented exactly once
units: nats, next-token cross-entropy; generation scores are scorer means over eight prompts, not sentence accuracy

protocol.presentation: every training window exactly once, in a fixed order; no replacement and no repeated pass
protocol.windows: data/windows_velenic.jsonl and data/windows_morvath.jsonl, in the order they were trained, with the held-out windows at the end

held_out_change.reading: the first two are loss reductions on the two held-out windows of the language being taught; the third is the change in the first language's held-out loss across the second teach, where a value near zero means it was kept

training_pool_loss_reduction_nats.reading: measured on the training windows themselves, before and after each teach; not a held-out measurement and not comparable with the held-out table

generations: answers/generations.json (80 continuations and 12 English controls, verbatim)

comparator.what: a low-rank adapter of matched trainable size, given the same bytes in the same order; the original comparator recording, with its own training schedule

limits: the adapter recording is the original comparator and is not a matched one-pass comparison
the continuation probe shows no consistent gain in vocabulary or morphology scores
